name: The Gallery Masterpiece: Painted in Code
description: The same 8 museum commission briefs as The Gallery Masterpiece, for models that write instead of paint: the model paints each brief as a single hand-written SVG (1536 × 1024; shapes, gradients and filters, no text, images or scripts). Headless Chromium renders it to a picture, and at least two vision judges from other companies judge that picture exactly like a generated painting: every line of the brief, then the artistry on anchored scales. Its own test and leaderboard column, never mixed with the image-generation test.
hook: No brush, no image model: can it paint a museum commission in pure SVG code?
author: Gauntlet Core
